name: Katakura Eimi
source:
Eimi is a young nun and teacher that works alongside [url=https://vndb.org/c63887]Shinobu[/url] at Saint Michael's Nursing School. She has a gentle and cheerful kind of personality. All students trust her, but she's not exactly a traditional nun. Let's just say that her love may not be exclusive only to God.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582494-kango-shicyauzo/faqs/36050]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
